name: Lakeland Community College
tuition_note: In-district (Lake County resident) tuition & fees from lakeland cc.edu/tuition, Spring 2026 term: $2,442.00 for 15 credits (tuition $142.75/cr + general fee $11.80/cr + career services fee $8.25/cr). Annual figure = 30 credits (Fall+Spring full-time) = $4,884. Housing: Lakeland is a public community college with no on-campus housing/dorms published anywhere on the site, so housing_cost is null.
